body:
maria: Quick ask — can we finalize the release note and internal blurb for tonight's micro-rollout to eu-west-1? ETA 22:00 UTC. We need: short public RN, internal one-pager, and an FAQ for the support channel. Also we want a 'lazy rollback' threshold (cpu error rate or latency) tied to deploy-bot.

devon: +1. I can draft the internal blurb. can someone give the final list of changed routes and the commit sha?

ryan: commit is `a1b2c3d4` (runtime patch). Changed: /generate, /batch-embed, and client-side header handling for long prompts. No DB migrations.

emma: I wrote a short public RN stub: "Small runtime patch to improve header handling and reduce tail latency on long prompts. No breaking changes." Should I paste?

maria: paste it, we'll trim. For internal, include canary criteria and rollback matrix (lazy rollback). devon — want the bullet list.

devon: Draft internal blurb: "Micro-rollout to eu-west-1 only. Canary for 30m at 5% traffic, then 25% for 30m, then full. Rollback triggers: error rate > 1.5x baseline for 5m OR p95 latency increase > 40% for 10m. On trigger, deploy-bot will auto-rollback to previous pinned version. Ops to escalate if rollback repeats twice."

maria: Looks good. Add a line about model/service pinning: "We pin runtime to v2.3.1 in eu-west-1; fallback to v2.3.0 in case of capacity pressure."

ryan: Adding deploybot cue here. Command we'll run (deploy-bot triggers):

```
/deploy --env eu-west-1 --service runtime --version v2.3.1 --canary 5% --monitor 30m --notes "runtime header fix"
```

deploy-bot: schedule accepted. Deploy window reserved: 2025-10-18 22:00 UTC — 22:45 UTC. Canary 5% start at 22:00. Notified: @oncall.

oncall-bot: oncall paging set for 22:00-23:00 UTC. Pager escalation: 10m after alert.

emma: RN public final: "Patch release: improves header handling and reduces tail latency in generation endpoints. Rolled out as a staged canary in EU. No API changes." Short FAQ for support:
- Q: Is this breaking? A: No.
- Q: Any action needed? A: No, clients are unaffected.
- Q: How long is the rollout? A: ~45 minutes.

devon: I'll post internal one-pager to #eng-releases + slack thread for support. Also adding a short section: "If rollback occurs, note affected region and version; open incident if repeated."

maria: Can we add one more note about metrics: ops please watch error-rate, p95 latency, and CPU/GPU utilization on the runtime pool. Tagging @devon and @ryan for dashboards.

ryan: dashboards: runtime/p95, runtime/error-rate, infra/gpu-util. All have alerts configured. Thresholds in the internal doc.

maria: Great. Final ask: who will post the internal announcement at T-30?

emma: I can post T-30 and pin the RN. I'll include the deploybot logs and a link to the one-pager.

maria: Perfect. If anything changes, call abort on the deploy-bot with `/deploy abort <id>` and notify oncall. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

emma: copied. posting at 21:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy started (canary 5%). id=deploy-1782345678-01. Monitoring now.

maria: thanks — keeping eyes on the thread.

deploy-bot: canary monitoring: error-rate at 0.6x baseline, p95 +8% — continuing.

deploy-bot: progressing to 25% after 30m.

deploy-bot: full rollout completed. No rollback triggered.

emma: posted final internal RN and pinned. Link: https://redwood.internal/rn/1782345678

maria: Excellent work — closing thread.
